description: Resolve dependencies from referenced database projects and report that schema objects depending on referenced objects compile into the requesting project package.

sql_files.View1.sql:
-- This view references Table1 which is created in the referenced project
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[View1]
  AS SELECT * FROM [Table1]

sql_files.Table1.sql:
CREATE TABLE [dbo].[Table1]
(
	c1 int NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
	c2 int NULL
)

cases.expected_output:
exit_code=0
package_exists=true
tables=
views=[dbo].[View1]
pre_deploy_script=false
post_deploy_script=false
diagnostics=none
